SHORT DESCRIPTION: Formula: 185 ______ Walk into a bar. Bartender says, "I can't serve you 185 _______". 185 _______ say, "Why not?". Bartender says, "(insert bad pun here)".
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Use different voice for bartender

Name: Action Line
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Imitate Schwarzenegger. Deliver cheesy one liner that's a pun on the object suggested
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Big action, use Schwarzenegger voice

Name: All About... Armando
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes inspired by a guest monologist. Buble scenes inspired by monologue, tangeant scenes from there. Combo of Armando and BSM.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Chairs Chicago style. Cast on Sidelines.

Name: Alphabet
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players must start each subsequent line with the next letter of the alphabet
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts.

Name: Armandito
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes inspired by a monologist
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Played from Wings. Monologist is downstage Center

Name: Armando
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes inspired by the player's monlogues
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Played from Wings. Monologist is downstage Center

Name: Arms Expert
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience member comes up on stage, one player interviews while the other sits behind the audience member and plays as their hands.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two Chairs placed one behind the other. Need to have Bottle of water, Tshirt voucher, and paper towels ready.

Name: Back in Time
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Start with a scene and then every subsequent scene happens before the scene that came before it.

Name: Bad Pickup Line
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience member comes up on stage and cast tries to "pick them up" using terrible pick up lines
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Chair for the Audience member. Sexy lights and music played low.

Name: Beastie Raps
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge game where players try to out rhyme each other
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: V or triangle formation. Challenger starts each round. Once eliminated move to back of V or triangle.

Name: Bedtime Story
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Musical Narrative led by a story teller
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Narrator stands by keyboard

Name: Beer Slacker Mice
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A grounded scene, then we follow the funny. Eventually we make our way back to that grounded scene, and repeat

Name: Bouncer
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 10 Celebrities, 10 fictional characters, 10 historical figures. the guesser is a bouncer that needs to guess them before allowing them in the club.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: One player is sent outside. Dry erase board on an easel. All players out. If their character is guessed, they need to go AROUND the back of the stage.

Name: By the Numbers
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 2 of the 3 players must speak only using a pre-determined number of words in each line
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts.

Name: Call'ems / Pillars
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two audience members are brought on stage, and have to fill in the blanks during the scene
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Depending on the version, audience members are either standing to the side or sitting up front. Players on stage at start for example.

Name: Chairs
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players pick up chairs and walk around until the audience says "Stop". This position inspires the scene.

Name: Complaint Department
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Items need to be returned, the guesser has to figure out what they are.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: One player is sent outside. The rest wait in the wings while the caller gets suggestions. They enter one at a time.

Name: CSI Miami
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Deliver terrible pun based a la David Carruso on CSI Miami. "Looks like this guy... ______________"
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Step up, deliver setup line, remove / put on glasses, deliver pun.

Name: Day in the Life
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience member is interviewed and the players perform a recreation of their day, progressively getting faster
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Bring audience member and sit them stage left, with their back towards backstage. Spotlight during the interviews. Full Wash / Appropriate lighting for the Day recreations.

Name: Dead Bodies
SHORT DESCRIPTION: One player continues playing despite their fellow players "dying" a few lines into thier "scene"
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two players start. One "dies". after a minute, the next player enters and soon thereafter "die".

Name: Deconstruction
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 3 grounded scenes inspired by three suggestions. Then players perform scenes by deconstructing those.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Played from Wings. Fade outs and self starts.

Name: Docudrama
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes happen. Occasionally someone will sit downstage center and deliver a "testemonial" that advances the plot

Name: Documentary
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An improvised documentary

Name: Don't Make Me Laugh
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge game. Players perform a scene trying NOT to make the audience laugh.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: V or triangle formation. Challenger starts each round. Once eliminated move to back of V or triangle.

Name: Doo Ron Ron
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge game. Rhyming game based on the titular song.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Stand in a line. Sing a song from 40 years ago no one remembers.

Name: Double Entendre
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Bad pun "I like my women/men how I like my______________"
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. sexy lights and music. Mime some sort of sexy or non sexy action when you walk up.

Name: Drinking Song (Cuban, Mexican, Irish)
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A Drinking song by four players one line at a time.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Four players standing downstage center

Name: Emotions
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A caller randomly calls out emotions previously suggested by the audience affecting the scene.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts. Caller stands off to downstage right or left with a clipboard. "freeze" between emotions

Name: Evil Chewing Gum
SHORT DESCRIPTION: There's an evil stick of chewing gum voiced by a player off stage.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts, one player is left on the microphone playing the invisible gum

Name: Excuses
SHORT DESCRIPTION: The guesser arrives late and needs to guess why they're late. Two other players mime clues behind the caller's back
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two players are "coworkers" or "students". One player is the guesser sent outside. One is the boss or teacher.

Name: Famous Person Who
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two audience members are brought on stage, and the cast treats one as a celebrity of the other's choosing. Audience member needs to guess who they are.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players in a backline, one audience member in the center of stage, one on stage left with one player and a dry erase board. Player with the board asks audience member for celebrity, or famous person dead or alive. Shows answer to audience and backline players. Switch players and repeat.

Name: First Line / Last Line
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Backline game. Players start each subsequent scene with the last line of the scene that came before it.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Transitional edits

Name: Follow the Leaver
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Every time a character leaves a scene we follow that character into the next scene.

Name: Forward Reverse
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Caller forwards and reverses the scene in play
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts. Short lines. Big Actions. Don't "freeze" between Fwd/Rev

Name: Four Corners
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Four scenes happen on a rotation. Caller moves them left and right.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Four players in the form of a square, caller off to stage right or left

Name: Four Corners 2-1-1
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A Mashup of Four Corners and Pick-a-line 411
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players stand in a square configuration. Two diagonal players take phones from the audience. Caller switches scene right or left.

Name: Freeze Tag (Normal or Blind)
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a scene. Players on backline will freeze them and start an entirely new scene by taking the previous player's body position.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline, Players clap and yell freeze

Name: Funeral
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Grab three suggestions. Suggestion one gets a grounded scene then play as if it were a Beer Slacker Mice. When it's time to come back to the grounded scene, do a grounded scene based on suggestion 2. After all three suggestions have been used for grounded scenes, begin to tie it together with callbacks, themes, etc.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: One player is laid across some chairs. Other players stand behind them. Once we're in scenes the game is played from the sidelines

Name: Good Bad Ugly
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience members ask questions and the players give them good, bad, and ugly answers
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Three players in a row. One gives good advice, one gives bad, the last one gives ugly advice. Caller gets questions from the audience.

Name: Harold
SHORT DESCRIPTION: There are whole books dedicated to this, and there's no way to explain it without drawing a chart. Audiences love it, improvisors love it.

Name: Hecklers
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a scene while other players sit in the audience and heckle.

Name: Ho-down
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A western song one line at a time
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Four players standing downstage center

Name: Home Shopping Network
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Three items, plus what's weird about them. Basically a game of charades with a home shopping network theme.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: One player is the host and is sent outside. Everyone else gets an object then what's weird about it. (Lawnmower -> Mows Snakes -> It's a snake mower) Get three of these. Rest of the players act it out Chertades style

Name: How did we get in here
SHORT DESCRIPTION: To Players pickup a story where they're in prison

Name: Impossible Scene
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge Game. Must perform a scene without using "Me, My, or I, or asking a question."
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players in Wings or V. Eliminated players go in the back.

Name: Improv Shakespeare
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An improvised narrative in the style of a Shakespearean play

Name: Interrogation
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Crime Locatio Object - The crook needs to guess what they did while the detectives dole out clues
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Chair in the center of stage. One player is the criminal sent outside during the askfors Crime - Location - Object

Name: Intervention
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A player is given an addiction. We see it play out throughout their lives.

Name: Invisibility
SHORT DESCRIPTION: One character is "invisible" voiced by a player off stage
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: One player in scene, another is invisible.

Name: Jeopardy
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience submits suggestions, and the players play a round of Double Jeopardy before moving onto Final Jeopardy
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Three players on Stage left standing behind chairs (or divided two and two if in challenge

Name: JTF Rap
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Get a current event and rap about it.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: All players in a line. Pre-recorded track.

Name: Kick-It
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a scne. Occasionally the beatboxer or caller will shout Kick-It and players have to rap until the caller says "Word" / Musical Narrative led by a beatboxer
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Microphone on stage Right. Players wait off stage until scene starts.

Name: Living Room
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Everyone sits living room style and shares truthful stories. Players then perform scenes based on those stories.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Three chairs set up stage left. Players discuss in the spotlight.

Name: Love Machine
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience member is brought up, blindfolded, and plays a round of the dating game with pre-determined characters

Name: Madam Zinda
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Similar to late excuses. Madam Zinda is a fortune teller who has to guess the fortune. The caller is the client getting his fortune told, and the other two improvisers are "spirits" that silently mime the fortune.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two chairs stage left in an L configuration. Fortune Teller Music, funky lighting. Madam/Mister Zinda is sent outside during Askfors. Two players come in as spirits once the guessing starts

Name: Madrigal
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 4-5 singers each sing one line to start and then combine in a cacophony of themes.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: 4-5 players standing downstage center in the spotlight

Name: Mannequins
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two audience members are brought up to move around the players as they please
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two players on stage. Two audience members are brought up to move them.

Name: Messing
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes are performed until they reach a high note. Then the players switch into different positions on stage and let this dynamic inspire the next scene.

Name: Montage
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A series of scenes inspired by other scenes

Name: Musical Narrative
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Narrative with musical underscore.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: played from the wings. Self Starts

Name: My Nickname in College
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A bad pun about why your nickname in college was whatever the audience suggests.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Players step up to downstage center

Name: Narrative Montage
SHORT DESCRIPTION: A series of scenes inspired by other scenes that eventually form a narrative.

Name: New Choice
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Caller rings a bell and prompts the players to make a new choice and justify.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait in wings until scene starts. Caller uses a bell to signal new choice

Name: Nightmare
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience member is interviewed and the players perform a series of scenes deconstructing the interview.

Name: Objection 1.0
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players are lawyers in a courtroom discussing two topics. They can Object and a "judge" will sustain or overrule the objection
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: two sets of chairs facing each other, one player dressed as judge in the middle

Name: Objection 2.0
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Backline game. Similar to Objection 1.0 but less scene based.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. 3 minute time limit.

Name: Panel of Experts
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience members ask questions and the players give them answers one word at a time
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Four Chairs lined up side by side. Caller brings out the "experts" who walk in to Vivaldi Springs. At the end it's lights out. No more walk out music.

Name: Party Quirks
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Guesser is throwing a party, has to guess the party-goer's quirks
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Party host is sent outside for the Ask-fors. Remaining players each get a quirk. Players enter one by one, but can all be on stage at the same time.

Name: Pick-a-Line 1.0
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience members pick 6 lines. Two players then perform a scene, and pick the lines out randomly.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two Players are sent into the hall. The players then come back in and read the lines sporadically

Name: Pick-a-Line 2.0
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Audience members submit lines before the show, players perform scenes from the backline occasionally picking out lines to fill the blanks
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Stool at center stage. Played from a backline.

Name: Pick-a-Line 4-1-1
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a scene occasionally filling in the blanks by reading text messages from audience phones
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Same as Four Corners 2-1-1 but with four phones. We've discoverd that 2 works better.

Name: Questions
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge game where players are only allowed to speak using questions.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players in Wings or V. Eliminated players go in the back.

Name: Rap Scene
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Similar to Shakespeare but the players recreate the scene using Hip Hop and a Beat Boxer
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: two players stage left doing normal scene. Two players stage right doing rap scene. Tech switches spotlights between scenes.

Name: Repeat Performance
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Group A of players goes outside. Groub B performs a scene. Group A comes back in to watch Group B perform the same scene in gibberish. Group A then tries to recreate whatever the scene was about.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Group A of players goes outside. Groub B performs a scene. Group A comes back in to watch Group B perform the same scene in gibberish. Group A then tries to recreate whatever the scene was about.

Name: Reverse Survivor
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 1 player stays on stage, the rest outside. Player 1 acts out a scene as if the others are there. Player two comes back in. Player 1 repeats everything exactly as they did originally, while Player 2 joins in. Player 3 enters. player 1 and 2 repeat exactly what they did, while P3 plays. Repeat as needed.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: 1 player stays on stage while the rest are sent outside. They come in one at a time after each scene is finished.

Name: Rick Hop Your Life
SHORT DESCRIPTION: a combination of Hip Hop your life, and JTF Rap.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Rick on keys. Players in a line.

Name: Rick-a-Line
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Pre-prepared lines based on current events. The cast hasn't seen the lines
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Cast is backline, lines are placed center stage in a vessel.

Name: Scene In Verse
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Each player's first line must rhyme with the second line of the other player
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts. Rhyme scheme is A-B, B-C, C-D, etc.

Name: Shakespeare Scene
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players A perform a scene on one side of the stage. Players B then recreate that scene in Shakespearean theme. Repeats until game end.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: two players stage left doing normal scene. Two players stage right doing shakespearean scene. Tech switches spotlights between scenes.

Name: Sit, stand, bend (lay)
SHORT DESCRIPTION: One player stands, one player sits, one player either bends or lays
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players on stage during suggestion assume positions before scene starts

Name: Slaps
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Challenge Game. using questions or don't make me laugh, but the losers get smacked in the face by the winners each time they lose a face off.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players in wings. Rotating based on elimination. Winner stays on, challenger enters scene. Played with Questions or dont make me laugh.

Name: Sound FX
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience member is brought on stage to perform sound fx for a scene, OR mic is passed around in the audience.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Audience member and coach are seated Stage Right. Microphone in front of Guest. Cast members are on stage before scene starts for demonstration

Name: Speed Dating
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a series of scenes by rotating through a speed dating scenario.

Name: Spotlight
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 3 players try to out-sing each other lounge style.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Played in Stage Right Spotlight next to the Piano.

Name: Story Story Die
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players line up and tell a story with a conductor. If they mess up, they're eliminated. May or may not include long excruciating death scene.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players stand in a line down stage. Caller directs the story.

Name: Story Story Die alt. Instruction Manual
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Exactly like Story Story Die, except instead of telling a story you're working through chapters in an instruction manual.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players stand in a line down stage. Caller directs the story.

Name: Styles / Genres
SHORT DESCRIPTION: SImilar to Emotions but with styles of movies
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts. Caller stands off to downstage right or left with a clipboard. "freeze" between styles

Name: Subconcious Mexican Restaurant
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two players are at a Mexican restaurant, occasionally another player will come out and sing their inner thoughts.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two chairs set up as if at a restaurant. One player off stage is a guitar player

Name: Survivor
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform a scene. The Audience votes one player out, remaining players need to recreate the scene filling in for that player. Repeat until only one player is doing all the parts
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players do a scene. then backline and the audience eliminates one via applause (play survivor music), repeat as needed.

Name: Table For Four
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two players perform all the characters at a dinner.

Name: Ten Scenes
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform Ten Scenes

Name: Ten Scenes - Toss Up
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Players perform Ten Scens. Occasionally the audience will throw flags on stage that have been pre-endowed with stipulations. Scenes remain with the stipulation until they are edited.

Name: The Club
SHORT DESCRIPTION: This opens with everyone except one is dancing in the background of a club. The music is played whle everyone dances along. After a few moments, the last cast member will come from the back, asking the audience member for the name of the club. This is usually a color and then a noun of some sort. Once the suggestions are recieved, the last cast member "finds" the club and then is welcomed. After that, random scenes play that are take place within this club. All scenes are inspired by the suggestion.

Name: The Event
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Scenes happen based on their location in time around a central nexus event.

Name: The Houdini
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Three players get the suggestions. Played from the backline.

Name: The Mamet
SHORT DESCRIPTION: The cast starts by scene painting a location. They then play in that location while entering and exiting.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Players Scene paint the room they're in.

Name: The Maverick (Formally The UCB)
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An interviewer talks to an audience member and gathers info. The players then perform a scene or scenes based on the information. Repeat as needed.

Name: The Unusuals
SHORT DESCRIPTION: We see a family and how audience suggested endowments impacts their day.

Name: The Wave
SHORT DESCRIPTION: 4 players are two sets of characters at a sporting event. Every time the wave happens the conversation switches between pairs
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Four chairs lined in a row center stage. All players in position when scene starts

Name: Things you can say
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Things you can say to your (Insert audience suggestion) that you can't say to your sifnificant object.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Players step up to downstage center

Name: Things You Never Hear
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Things you'd never see or here at audience suggested locations or periods in history
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Players step up to downstage center

Name: Third Date
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two players are on a third date.

Name: Translators
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two players perform a scene in gibberish, two other players provide the translation for the scene.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Chairs positioned downstage left and right for translators. Players wait in the wings for scene to start.

Name: Two-Line Vocab
SHORT DESCRIPTION: two of the three players are only allowed to speak using two lines supplied to them each by the audience.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players are on stage when the suggestions are received.

Name: Uber Driver
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Driver picks up fares. Has to guess the client's quirks
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Guesser leaves to go outside. Four chairs set up in car configuration. Other players wait backstage during Ask-fors.

Name: Universal Remote
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Similar to Forward Reverse but with more options limited only by the caller's imagination
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Players wait off stage until scene starts. Caller yells "Freeze" or "pause" between everything except Fwd / rev

Name: Up Your Alley
SHORT DESCRIPTION: An audience expert is brought on stage, two players perform as other experts in the same field.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Three chairs center stage. Audience member is brought up first, and asked what they do for a living. THEN the players come out as also experts in that field.

Name: Wakeup
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Two players wake up.

Name: World's Worst
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Short scenes based on the worlds worst version of an audience supplied occupation
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Backline. Players step up to downstage center

Name: You Tell Us
SHORT DESCRIPTION: During the scene the caller stops to ask the audience for suggestions.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Two players in the wings until the performance starts.

Name: Your Life in Hip Hop
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Interview an audience member and then rap about their life.
SETUP / EDITS / STAGE DIRECTION: Similar setup to Day in the life, but their life is rapped about to a pre-recorded track. Order is Chorus twice, verse, chorus, verse, Chorus, Bridge, Verse, Chorus, twice.

Name: New Game Test
SHORT DESCRIPTION: Custom game added from show 11
